why: Sharpening bloodline, which is the first list this session to beat the champion at a real table: 57/400 against 50/400, and combat damage 35.98 against 29.07 -- the exact number the swarm build collapsed on. Six swaps from two independent sources agreeing with the Forge evidence. H1 REMOVE THE BLOCKERS RATHER THAN OUT-SIZE THEM: Grave Pact makes every token death an edict on the whole table, which deletes the blockers that made 1/1s worthless instead of trying to punch through them. H2 Yawgmoth, Thran Physician is a free sacrifice outlet AND removal AND the dig, in one card the pilot already owns. H3 Necropotence, also owned, because the modelled draw is four cards and the rest is sacrifice-gated. H4 Swords to Plowshares is the format's #11 card and sits in 67% of Edgar decks; this one ran none. Phyrexian Altar over a colourless outlet because mana-analysis has flagged the colour gap on every version. Priest of Forgotten Gods is drain, edict, draw and ramp on one two-mana body. Cuts are by format consensus: Vish Kal at #15903 was my pick and seven mana, and the field disagrees hard.
